resources.name: Fused silica refractive index measurements (60 wavelengths)

access.notes: CSV file with columns 'wavelength_um' (float) and 'refractive_index' (float). Arithmetical‑mean refractive index at 20°C for three fused silica specimens, reconstructed from the paper’s Table I.
numpy, scipy, matplotlib. Installable via pip (e.g. from Tsinghua mirror).
